summary:
Architectural Blueprint and Implementation Plan for VitalEcho:
- Frontend: Retro-futurist Glitch Art interface with one-click Google Sign-In, real-time Firestore sync listeners, interactive diagnostic record vault with filterable categories, scan viewer, and voice audio readouts.
- Backend: Express Node.js engine with rate-limit resilient Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal vision analysis (/api/gemini/analyze-report), metadata extraction, and clinical fallback engine.
- Database: Cloud Firestore enterprise database (ai-studio-0b836e2c-612e-4da2-8d8a-1b372a453659) with strict security rules, subcollection hierarchy (users/{userId}/medical_reports/{reportId}), and audit timestamps for isowri4ku@gmail.com.
